sources.label: Custom Morphe patches for multiple Android apps
sources.author: Beetle
patch_list: Enables Avatar Builder items marked as subscription-only without changing coin-priced item checks.
Suppresses JailMonkey root, hook, and ADB detection results for inspection. Does not disable Pairip, VPN checks, or TLS certificate validation.
Enables verified client-side Explore filters, including Last online within 48 hours and New Members Only, and raises excluded-country and excluded-topic selection limits.
Disables Pairip's client-side installer and license enforcement.
Allows HTTPS inspection using an installed user CA certificate while retaining certificate and hostname validation and blocking cleartext traffic. Does not bypass native Pairip protection.
